name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Dasari, Eklund, and Regolith go with Europa, Luna, and Titan, in some order.
Either Bauer goes with Regolith, or Drift goes with Europa — but not both.
Anders goes with exactly two of Forge, Callisto, and Lichen.
Titan goes with Lichen if and only if Geode goes with Anders.
Between Dasari and Forge, one goes with Callisto and the other with Luna.
Beacon goes with exactly two of Anders, Luna, and Plankton.
